description: Compute week-1 retention by weekly signup cohort for the content platform. The cohort is the ISO week (Monday start) of the user's signup_date. A user is retained in week 1 if they have at least one activity whose UTC date falls between signup_date + 7 days and signup_date + 13 days inclusive (measured per user, relative to the user's own signup date). Output columns: cohort_week (DATE, the Monday), cohort_size (INT64), retained_users (INT64), retention_rate (FLOAT64, 4 decimals).
edge_cases: User 2 is active on day 6 and day 14 only, so is not retained in week 1
Sunday 2025-06-08 belongs to the ISO week starting Monday 2025-06-02
Users with no activity at all remain in the cohort denominator
Multiple activities in the window count the user once
common_failure_modes: FM4: DATE_TRUNC(signup_date, WEEK) starts weeks on Sunday in BigQuery; WEEK(MONDAY) or ISOWEEK is required
FM2: Off-by-one window (days 6-12 or 8-14) misclassifies users on the boundary days
FM1: INNER JOIN to activity_log removes inactive users from cohort_size
